title: Pallet: The Wireless Supply Station
description: Never run out of materials mid-build again. Place a Pallet, stock it up, and it automatically refills your hotbar from a distance.
body:
Pallet: The Wireless Supply Station

Place a Pallet, stock it up, and it automatically refills your hotbar when you run out of an item. Upgrade your antenna for greater range and power.

---

## The Four Tiers

- **Basic Pallet** — 10 block range, requires line of sight
- **Reinforced Copper Pallet** — 32 block range, works through glass and leaves  
- **Golden Frequency Pallet** — 64 block range, works through any block
- **Echoing Void Pallet** — Unlimited range across the entire dimension

---

## Requirements
- Minecraft 1.20.1
- Forge 47.3.0+
